plan.notes: Official UMF archived 2023-2024 Undergraduate Catalog, Elementary Education B.S. Required Professional Courses (Total Major Requirements 63 credits). The catalog publishes major requirements with no official semester sequence — collected as a single requirements block per coordinator 2026-10-09 convention. EDU 450 is listed as 7.5 credits 'for a total 15 credits'; recorded at 15 credits. The Specific General Education Requirements (PSY 225 and two MAT courses) and the required concentration or minor are separate from the 63 professional credits and are not transcribed here.
